## Blog

- [Best 3D Printing Websites for Files: 2026 Maker Guide](https://moorecode.com/blog/best-3d-printing-websites-files-2026.html): Compare Printables, MakerWorld, Thingiverse, MyMiniFactory, and Thangs by the job, file detail, and commercial-use path.
- [Desktop 3D Printing Setup: A Safe Beginner Workspace](https://moorecode.com/blog/desktop-3d-printing-setup-safe-workspace.html): Plan the surface, clearance, ventilation, tools, storage, and separate resin workflow for a home 3D-printing station.
- [3D Printing a Prototype: Four Stages, One Test Plan](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printing-prototype-four-stage-test-plan.html): Choose a process and material for visual, fit, functional, and pilot prototypes by starting with a measurable test.
- [3D Printing Filament: PLA, PETG, or TPU?](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printing-filament-pla-petg-tpu.html): Choose PLA, PETG, or TPU by the job. Compare print temperatures, strengths, tradeoffs, and beginner settings in one practical guide.
- [Free blackjack basic strategy trainer for iPhone compared](https://moorecode.com/blog/free-blackjack-basic-strategy-trainer-iphone.html): Five free iPhone blackjack basic strategy trainers compared on ads, in-app purchases, and rule settings. One of them is my own app, Blackjack Now.
- [Mileage tracker for delivery drivers: IRS deduction rules](https://moorecode.com/blog/mileage-tracker-delivery-drivers-tax-deduction.html): Which delivery miles count as business miles, the 2026 IRS rate of 72.5 and 76 cents, and what a mileage log needs. Includes a worked example.
- [Invoicing app pricing for service businesses, compared](https://moorecode.com/blog/simple-invoicing-app-pricing-service-businesses.html): Pricing for five invoicing tools a small service business shortlists, with free-plan invoice limits and what 60 invoices a month cost on each.
- [What Is FDM 3D Printing? FDM vs. SLA and SLS](https://moorecode.com/blog/what-is-fdm-3d-printing.html): FDM 3D printing melts filament into layers. See how FDM works, where it fits, and how it compares with SLA resin and SLS powder printing.
- [When Resin 3D Printing Beats FDM](https://moorecode.com/blog/when-resin-3d-printing-beats-fdm.html): Choose resin 3D printing for fine detail and smooth surfaces. Compare it with FDM, then plan the washing, curing, ventilation, and PPE.
- [3D Printmaking Checklist: Mirrored Art to Inked Proof](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printmaking-checklist-mirrored-art-inked-proof.html): A practical relief-printing checklist from mirrored digital art through an inked proof.
- [7 Fused Deposition Modelling Mistakes to Fix](https://moorecode.com/blog/fused-deposition-modelling-mistakes-to-fix.html): A symptom-first guide to first layers, flow limits, orientation, supports, and safe printer placement.
- [3D Printing Metal: Four Processes Compared](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printing-metal-processes-compared.html): Powder bed fusion, binder jetting, metal FFF, and directed energy deposition compared by workflow and best use.
